comment: Build input for the bundled domain-coverage index (policy-index.bin).
PLACEHOLDER DATA. Every domain here is an RFC 2606 / RFC 6761 reserved name that resolves
to nobody. Risk levels are illustrative so the badge path can be exercised end to end.
Real domains belong here ONLY once an actual analysis backs them, published through the
M1 corpus pipeline. Shipping an invented risk level for a real company would be a false
claim about that company, visible to every user who installs the extension.
The bundle is a day-one offline SEED, not the source of truth (AD-6). promptVersion lives
in the CDN index so re-analysis can be invalidated without an extension release.
